name: HoloMeeting VR - Showroom & Training
summary:
HoloMeeting VR is a VR showroom available anywhere, featuring realistic, detailed virtual versions of your products. You can examine them up close, step inside them, view them at full scale even if they’re enormous, or enlarge them if they’re small. Product simulations can include mechanical movements (they can be running!), visual effects and explanations. HoloMeeting VR is more effective than a showroom of physical products!
